CustomObject.description: Defines donor giving tiers for the Fundraising Quick Start. Each record represents one tier with one-time, annual, and lifetime minimum gift amount thresholds, an internal key, and a branded display name. Tiers drive the DonorGiftSummary FQS_*_Donor_Level__c formula fields, the FQS_Is_*_Commitment__c band checkboxes on Gift Commitment, and the FQS_Is_*_Gift__c band checkboxes on Gift Transaction. Admins can adjust thresholds, names, and credit-type behavior in Setup without redeployment.
CustomObject.label: FQS Donor Tier
